build_infinity_embedding_url: build the complete Infinity embedding API URL from api_base, model, and optional parameters
validate_infinity_environment: validate the Infinity embedding environment and return merged authorization headers
transform_infinity_embedding_request: transform OpenAI-style embedding request into Infinity API request format
transform_infinity_embedding_response: transform Infinity API response into standard EmbeddingResponse with model, data, and usage
map_openai_params_to_infinity: map OpenAI embedding params like encoding_format, modality, and dimensions to Infinity API params
